python3 << 'PYEOF'
import os, json, base64, sys

key_file = os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')
if key_file:
    with open(key_file) as f:
        api_key = f.read().strip()
else:
    api_key = os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY', '')

# R script
r_script = '''
# Read data
d <- read.csv("input.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# Filter: exclude strain 1 (not part of 287/98 system)
d <- d[d$StrainNumber != 1, ]

# Compute proportion of strain 287
# For pure strains: 287 -> 1, 98 -> 0
# For mixtures (287_98): parse Ratio like "1:3" -> 1/(1+3)
compute_prop <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == 287) return(1.0)
  if (strain == 98) return(0.0)
  # mixture 287_98
  parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio, ":")[[1]])
  return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
}

d$Proportion <- mapply(compute_prop, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)

# Fit models
m2 <- lm(Area ~ poly(Proportion, 2, raw=TRUE), data=d)
m3 <- lm(Area ~ poly(Proportion, 3, raw=TRUE), data=d)
library(splines)
mns <- lm(Area ~ ns(Proportion, df=4), data=d)

# Compare AIC
aics <- c(Quadratic=AIC(m2), Cubic=AIC(m3), NaturalSpline=AIC(mns))
best_model_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- switch(best_model_name,
  Quadratic = m2,
  Cubic = m3,
  NaturalSpline = mns
)

# Find proportion that maximizes predicted area
pred_area <- function(x) {
  if (best_model_name == "Quadratic") {
    predict(best_model, newdata=data.frame(Proportion=x))
  } else if (best_model_name == "Cubic") {
    predict(best_model, newdata=data.frame(Proportion=x))
  } else {
    predict(best_model, newdata=data.frame(Proportion=x))
  }
}

opt <- optimize(pred_area, interval=c(0, 1), maximum=TRUE)
optimal_prop <- opt$maximum
max_area <- opt$objective

# Output results
cat("BestModel:", best_model_name, "\\n", sep="")
cat("AIC_Quadratic:", aics["Quadratic"], "\\n", sep="")
cat("AIC_Cubic:", aics["Cubic"], "\\n", sep="")
cat("AIC_NaturalSpline:", aics["NaturalSpline"], "\\n", sep="")
cat("OptimalProportion:", optimal_prop, "\\n", sep="")
cat("MaxPredictedArea:", max_area, "\\n", sep="")

# Also output as tabular
result <- data.frame(
  BestModel = best_model_name,
  AIC_Quadratic = aics["Quadratic"],
  AIC_Cubic = aics["Cubic"],
  AIC_NaturalSpline = aics["NaturalSpline"],
  OptimalProportion = optimal_prop,
  MaxPredictedArea = max_area
)
write.csv(result, "result.csv", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
'''

# Base64 encode the script
script_b64 = base64.b64encode(r_script.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')

# Build UDT representation
udt = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "colony-area-model-fitting-v1",
    "name": "Colony Area Model Fitting",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/r-base:4.4.1",
    "shell_command": (
        'SCRIPT_B64="' + script_b64 + '"\n'
        'python3 -c \'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("fit.R").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))\' "$SCRIPT_B64"\n'
        'Rscript fit.R "$(inputs.input.path)"\n'
        'set -eu\n'
        'SCRIPT_B64="' + script_b64 + '"\n'
        'python3 -c \'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("fit.R").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))\' "$SCRIPT_B64"\n'
        'cp "$(inputs.input.path)" input.csv\n'
        'Rscript fit.R\n'
    ),
    "inputs": [
        {
            "name": "input",
            "type": "data",
            "format": ["csv"]
        }
    ],
    "outputs": [
        {
            "name": "result",
            "type": "data",
            "format": "csv",
            "from_work_dir": "result.csv"
        }
    ]
}

print(json.dumps(udt, indent=2))
